native.os_edition: Actual reviewed pinned reference version, distinct a claim of full current IEC specification.
native.os_service: Actual safety management, process data, ordinary service data or slim service data.
native.os_direction: Actual transmit or receive observation; no assumed controller equals consumer role.
native.os_node_role: Actual Safety Node, Configuration Manager or Domain Gateway.
native.os_configuration: Actual device configuration versus source demonstration or explicitly requested minimum supported configuration.
native.os_mapping_state: Actual node state when changing SOD mappings, not UI progress status.
native.os_outcome: Actual functional result separate frame validity or safety certification.
native.os_bearer_id: Actual separately registered black-channel TechnologyProfile, not openSAFETY itself or always Ethernet.
native.os_bearer_source: Actual transport topology, framing, service/load/loss and integrity assumptions of black channel.
native.os_device_source: Actual stack/device revision, enabled services, configured limits and capabilities.
native.os_timer_source: Actual implementation clock tick and monotonic/wrap behavior, not assumed100ms CAN timer.
native.os_frame_source: Actual two-subframe observation including layout, normalized domain/UDID and checksum verification.
native.os_acceptance_source: Actual correlated data acceptance, freshness and application validity requirement.
native.os_assurance_source: Actual hazard/safety-case and certificate applicability evidence; a reference stack is not NIS certification.
native.os_udid_hex: Actual six-byte unique device identity, not invented from node number or automatically taken as Ethernet MAC.
native.os_scm_udid_hex: Actual configured six-byte Configuration Manager identity for domain/subframe processing.
native.os_mapping_source: Actual SOD entries/types/order/max-variable-length and application range-validation evidence.
native.os_domain: Actual Safety Domain Number, independent black-channel network identifier.
native.os_address: Actual assigned safety address, independent CAN/IP address.
native.os_time_address: Actual ten-bit time request address; zero/not-used depends selected service.
native.os_time_request: Actual six-bit time-request distinctive number, not a packet retry count.
native.os_frame_id: Actual six-bit service identifier, address high bits encoded separately.
native.os_data_length: Actual openSAFETY LE payload length, excludes redundant copy/headers/checksums.
native.os_crc_bytes: Actual checksum size per subframe, one for LE<=8 and two for LE>=9.
native.os_crc_polynomial: Actual source-version-qualified generator, not a generic CRC16 or an older-edition value.
native.os_crc_initial: Actual reference calculation initial register, zero for these selected checksums.
native.os_subframe1_bytes: Actual first subframe including four header bytes, payload and checksum.
native.os_subframe2_bytes: Actual second subframe including five header bytes/checksum and ordinary redundant payload.
native.os_frame_bytes: Actual whole safety frame; ordinary2*LE+11/13, slimLE+11/13; separate bearer.
native.os_bearer_overhead_bytes: Actual encapsulation overhead on selected black channel, no universal Ethernet22/IP20.
native.os_wire_bytes: Actual carried safety frame plus chosen bearer overhead; no physical baud inferred.
native.os_bearer_limit_bytes: Actual registered bearer/device unit limit at the declared frame boundary.
native.os_max_ssdo_payload: Actual SSDO-server configured maximum8..254; demo12 versus minimum-supported8 distinct actual application payload.
native.os_max_tx_spdo_payload: Actual configured maximum TxSPDO, reference allows at most254.
native.os_max_rx_spdo_payload: Actual configured maximum RxSPDO, reference allows at most254.
native.os_mapped_bytes: Actual sum of mapped maximum sizes in a byte-based mapping, not count of variables.
native.os_mapped_entries: Actual number of valid SOD mapping entries, matching subindex0.
native.os_tick_us: Actual duration of one application consecutive-time tick; no literature-wide default from an unspecified target.
native.os_refresh_ticks: Actual TxSPDO Refresh Prescale in application ticks, not a global publish period.
native.os_refresh_us: Actual refresh time converted with the identified clock tick.
native.os_sct_ticks: Actual per-consumer Safety Control Time, not a CAN timeout or functional safety guarantee.
native.os_sct_us: Actual SCT converted with source-qualified tick; separate total fault-reaction time.
native.os_tx_call_ticks: Actual maximum interval between BuildTxSpdo calls, at most the smallest configured active TxSPDO refresh.
native.os_rx_check_ticks: Actual maximum interval between CheckRxTimeout calls, at most the smallest configured active RxSPDO SCT.
native.os_minimum_refresh_ticks: Actual minimum refresh across all active TxSPDOs, not inferred from one selected connection.
native.os_minimum_sct_ticks: Actual minimum SCT across all active RxSPDOs, not inferred from one selected connection.
native.os_elapsed_ticks: Actual time since valid consumer data, checked against SCT before accepting data.
native.os_propagation_min_ticks: Actual permitted minimum propagation delay from SOD.
native.os_propagation_max_ticks: Actual permitted maximum propagation delay, not assumed zero or Ethernet delay.
native.os_consecutive_time: Actual UInt16 wire consecutive time, modular comparison distinct UInt32 local clock.
native.os_previous_consecutive_time: Actual last validated wire time on same SPDO producer.
native.os_consecutive_distance: Actual UInt16 modular delta; only differences<32768 pass CT_VALID.
native.os_local_clock: Actual application UInt32 consecutive timer clock, not necessarily milliseconds.
native.os_timeout_at: Actual UInt32 deadline constructed with same clock and bounded offset.
native.os_fault_reaction_bound_us: Actual assured total detection/stack/application/output fault reaction, not SCT alone.
native.os_fault_reaction_required_us: Actual hazard-derived maximum accepted reaction time.
native.os_age_us: Actual accepted source data age distinct frame receipt/CRC/SCT.
native.os_freshness_limit_us: Actual application accepted source-age bound, not universal safety-bus default.
native.os_connection_valid: Actual producer connection-valid indication, separate CRC and consumer acceptance.
native.os_crc1_valid: Actual source-qualified first subframe checksum result, not a calculated checksum in this parameter model.
native.os_crc2_valid: Actual source-qualified second subframe checksum result, independent first checksum.
native.os_subframes_consistent: Actual normalized headers/domain/UDID/data agreement after source-defined masking, not raw identical subframes.
native.os_synchronized: Actual completed time synchronization for receiving SPDO data.
native.os_first_after_sync: Actual first frame whose CT is checked after sync; reference keeps data safe on that frame.
native.os_safe_state: Actual consumer safe state, not assumed false because a frame arrived.
native.os_timeout_expired: Actual modular local-clock timeout result under identified reference comparison.
native.os_mapping_changed: Whether mappings are currently being modified; only pre-operational state permitted.
native.os_range_validated: Actual application performed mapped object range/type checks, which stack mapping does not provide.
native.os_data_accepted: Actual functional application consumption separate safety certification.
native.os_safety_case_confirmed: Actual complete hazard/system safety case applicability, never defaulted by protocol name.
native.os_certificate_scope_match: Actual certificate covers exact device/firmware/system use, not this simulation model.
native.os_safety_accepted: Actual externally supported safety assurance result, not a checkbox proving SIL.
native.payload_bytes: Actual application bytes distinct source-defined safety frame LE, duplicated payload, SSDO segmentation and black-channel frame limits. No universal CAN8 or Ethernet1500 ceiling.

revisions: Archived B&R/IXXAT reference distribution1.4, pinned commit. README demonstration1.4.0; version.txt says1.4. No current complete licensed EPSG/IEC specification or NIS certification claimed.
SFS frame constants: two headers4/5, payload0..254, short0..8 CRC1 versus long9..254 CRC2, domain1..1023. Read pinned reference.
Valid six-bit service IDs, serialization and slim-SSDO layout distinct ordinary duplicated payload.
Length/header/CRC/subframe validation. SlimSSDO58/59 omits second payload and selects separate long checksum routine.
Address/TR/UDID/timeout-width/SOD constants; UInt32 timer modular comparison and UInt16 wire consecutive time.
Configurable stack limits and demonstration settings; demoSSDO12, Rx/TxSPDO128 are not universal protocol or application defaults.
Reference tools use CRC8 polynomial2F, ordinary CRC16BAAD, slimCRC16AC9A. Do not substitute Modbus, CAN or an older edition polynomial.
Actual time synchronization, propagation and SCT consumer checks; first frame after synchronization remains safe until timing validated.
Call frequency tied to smallest refresh/SCT, actual application supplied consecutive-time clock; no fixed milliseconds inferred.
Request tracking, synchronization and actual propagation bounds; request counter and configured unanswered-request count distinct.
Pre-operational mapping changes and byte-based mapping; actual valid-connection status and application range checks.
scope: Each declared type/unit/bound/meaning/dependency/default/provenance reviewed against pinned B&R/IXXAT reference distribution 1.4 commit 630495210c5aab1b39884b7b5c8feef62e95f245. Archived implementation, not current full IEC/EPSG conformance. Primary source files hashed and read.
Independent industry-neutral black channel; no Ethernet speed/frame or CAN parameters. Registration and public catalog domain now agree, 125 public profiles. Runtime capacity remains MODEL_MISSING.

Ordinary two-subframe geometry duplicates LE0..254, slim SSDO omits second payload. LE0..8 CRC8_2F versus9..254 CRC16_BAAD or slimAC9A, zero initial register. Checksum outputs explicitly actual external verification; no implemented whole codec/CRC proof claimed.

Actual ten-bit safety/domain/manager addresses, six-byte UDID, service-specific six-bit frame IDs, actual bearer encapsulation/limits and SOD mapping distinct application bytes. Demo SSDO12/SPDO128 and minimum-supported SSDO8 are configuration-qualified proposals; no fabricated addresses or safety confirmations.

Actual clock units and UInt16 wire CT versus UInt32 local timer wraps, propagation intervals and SCT consumer gates. SCT pointer UInt16 in this pinned implementation despite an api comment naming SCT_U32. Actual smallest active refresh/SCT bounds periodic stack calls; no assumed100ms. First frame after synchronization remains safe, accepted data requires valid connection, checksums, application ranges and timing.

CRC/SCT alone do not confirm system safety case/certificate scope or total fault reaction. Actual freshness and assurance evidence preserved. Confirmed tick100/SCT42/payload64/UDID survive rejection of foreign CAN rate.
